added.long_description:
Micora is a next-generation robotic energy developer that compresses the timeline from initial design to power generation from years to weeks. Our vertically integrated platform combines purpose-built robotic hardware with proprietary modular energy systems, enabling critical power infrastructure to be designed, manufactured, and deployed at unprecedented speed.

Traditional energy projects are slow, costly, and built around processes that were never designed for today’s rapidly growing power demands. Micora is rebuilding energy development from the ground up; transforming what has historically been a bespoke, multi-year construction process into a repeatable and scalable manufacturing system.

As demand from data centers, advanced manufacturing, and electrification strains existing power infrastructure, the ability to deploy new generation quickly is becoming increasingly valuable. Micora is building the infrastructure platform needed to deliver power wherever and whenever it is needed.
added.one_liner: Solar farm in a box built anywhere in days

long_description.before:
Forge helps companies recover tariffs and duties paid on imported goods that are later exported or scrapped by automating a process called duty drawback.

Billions of dollars of eligible refunds go unclaimed every year. We take full ownership of the process from organizing data to filing claims so businesses can unlock this extra revenue with minimal effort.
long_description.after:
Forge manages international logistics for business around the world. We’re an AI native freight forwarder, customs broker, and tariff expert.

We’re growing rapidly and support small mom and pop business to the Fortune 1000s, including companies like Allegiant Airlines, Malbon Golf, and R.E.M. beauty.

Forge has raised capital from world class investors including Google, Y-Combinator, and Gradient Ventures.

one_liner.before: Getting companies refunds on tariffs & duties
one_liner.after: AI native freight forwarder and customs broker

long_description.before:
Banks and fintechs have large teams of human analysts who conduct manual checks and reviews. We replace those human compliance analysts with AI agents that automate 80% of the manual work for faster and more compliant financial crime (AML) reviews.

Our first three products are: Screening AI (discount 91% of screening alerts), KYB/C AI (speed up onboarding), Transaction Monitoring AI (handle AML transaction monitoring alerts)

Our end goal is to have a whole suite of AI workers that can handle manual compliance work for banks and fintechs. A $24B opportunity in the US alone.
long_description.after: Arva AI is a Google backed research company deploying autonomous AI decisioning for critical banking operations, combining proprietary models, adaptive decisioning agents and controlled continuous-learning infrastructure. Large banks and public financial institutions use Arva’s robust and auditable AI to improve the effectiveness, accuracy and repeatability of high-risk decisions.

one_liner.before: AI Agents to scale AML, KYB and KYC operations

long_description.before:
Blaxel is the perpetual sandbox platform for AI agents that need to run code fast.

Unlike traditional sandboxes that expire or suffer from cold starts, our sandboxes automatically scale to zero after 1s of inactivity and resume in under 25ms with full memory state preserved — allowing you to keep millions of secure sandboxes on standby indefinitely.

We also co-locate your agent logic alongside these sandboxes to eliminate network overhead, delivering near-instant latency for end users.
long_description.after:
Blaxel is the infrastructure foundation for autonomous agents.

Engineered for the way agents actually run, Blaxel gives builders deep control over compute (sandboxes), storage (shared filesystem), and networking as built-in infra primitives.

Unlike traditional sandboxes that expire or suffer from cold starts, our sandboxes automatically scale to zero after 1s of inactivity and resume in under 25ms with full memory state preserved — allowing you to keep millions of secure sandboxes on standby indefinitely.

long_description.before:
Knowledge work is being restructured by AI. Strategy happens in Claude. Research happens in ChatGPT. Building happens in Claude Code. The people defining the next decade of work are already thinking with AI every day. But none of that thinking compounds. Every session starts from zero. The reasoning behind decisions, the context behind strategies, the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations - all of it evaporates.

Nessie is the infrastructure that makes it permanent. We auto-sync AI conversations and agent traces across every major provider - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and more - and turn them into a context layer that is queryable, reusable, and shareable by you, your team, and your agents. No browser extension. No manual capture. Your thinking flows in automatically and compounds over time.

Where we are going: the AI-native organization runs thousands of agents that are powerful but amnesiac, and Nessie is the layer that integrates what the organization knows, what it has decided, and how its thinking has evolved. Science has journals, law has case law, software has git; AI-native knowledge work has had nothing. We are building it.

We are two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers. Backed by BoxGroup, Pioneer Fund, Y Combinator, Precursor, and more.

https://nessielabs.com
long_description.after:
Knowledge work is being restructured by AI. Strategy happens in Claude. Research happens in ChatGPT. Building happens in Claude Code and Codex. Meetings get recorded, notes get written, agents run for hours and leave behind traces nobody reads. The people defining the next decade of work are already thinking with AI every day. But none of that thinking compounds. Every session starts from zero. The reasoning behind decisions, the context behind strategies, the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations - all of it evaporates.

Nessie is the infrastructure that makes it permanent. We auto-sync AI conversations and agent traces across every major provider - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, and more - alongside meetings, notes, and email from tools like Granola, Read AI, Plaud, and Obsidian. Everything a team produces with AI flows into one place and compounds over time.

Nessie turns that raw, heterogeneous data into an ontology: the live state of a company. Not a static schema but a continuously updated record of what the company knows, what it has decided, who owns what, and how its thinking has evolved, kept current as new work flows in. It is queryable from any agent through our CLI, MCP connector, and plugins, shareable across a team with real permissions, and deployable on-prem for organizations that need it.

Then the loop closes. Once a company’s state is legible to its agents, every agent run becomes training signal: which skills worked, which failed, which workflows keep repeating. Nessie feeds that signal back as reviewable improvements to the skills, prompts, and processes the team runs on. This is what makes a company recursive: its agents get better from its own history, the people working with them get better too, and the compounding never stops.

Where we are going: the AI-native organization runs thousands of agents that are powerful but amnesiac. Nessie is the layer that gives them, and the humans steering them, a shared memory. Science has journals, law has case law, software has git; AI-native knowledge work has had nothing. We are building it.

Founded by two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers, now a team of three in San Francisco. Backed by BoxGroup, Pioneer Fund, Y Combinator, Precursor, and more.

https://nessielabs.com

long_description.before:
Markit helps teams navigate complex regulatory requirements across markets, bringing research, evidence, collaboration, and decision-making into one place.

The goal: accelerate speed to market, strengthen compliance, reduce regulatory risk, and give teams a clearer path from question to decision.

From market entry and product launches to ongoing compliance, Markit is built for the work that happens behind the scenes—and across borders.

Built for the work behind every decision.
long_description.after: MarkIt is an AI-powered regulatory compliance platform that helps consumer brands launch products in new markets. We review formulations, packaging, and supporting documents against local regulations, identify compliance gaps, and provide the exact changes, regulatory references, and market-ready labels needed before launch. We are initially focused on cosmetics and food products entering the U.S., replacing weeks of manual work across regulatory consultants, spreadsheets, and disconnected vendors with one actionable compliance workflow.

one_liner.after: Compliance that makes products ready for global markets.

long_description.before: We build environments and evals for frontier research agents. In these environments, models carry out research engineering work such as optimizing an algorithm, deploying a model, or running experiments to solve a novel problem. A grader scores the agent’s performance, and these scores serve as signals during evaluations.
long_description.after:
We build custom evals for product teams, as a service. To build these eval sets, we source domain experts and have them turn their work into original, real world evals.

For example, our research engineering experts have create tasks involving optimizing an algorithm, deploying a model, or running experiments to solve a novel problem. A grader scores the agent’s performance, and these scores serve as signals during evaluations.

long_description.before: We enable AI voice agents to collect payments over the phone through a single API call, handling card processing and PCI compliance across all payment gateways
long_description.after: We enable AI chat and voice agents to collect payments through a single API call, handling card processing and PCI compliance across all payment gateways

long_description.before:
Tenet Industries is building low-cost mass-producible defense systems, starting with attack drones.

We're using design-for-manufacturing and first principles to reimagine how a defense product is developed and manufactured. We begin with the manufacturing, then solve all the inefficiencies and difficulties in the firmware/software. This allows us to hyperscale production in multiple defense categories such as strike drones, loitering munitions, jammers, radars, etc.

Our first product is a kamikaze quadcopter. It assembles in two minutes and has half the parts to comparable systems.
long_description.after:
Tenet Industries is building AI-automated factories for manufacturing of PCBAs.

We're using AI and robotics to build a factory in München for instant-quote, fast-turnaround PCBA manufacturing and electronic manufacturing services.

long_description.before: GodHands is building a living knowledge base for engineering teams, turning the code, docs, and decisions across your stack into a single source of truth that stays accurate as you grow.
long_description.after: GodHands makes employee transitions seamless and ensures that critical knowledge is captured for posterity. We reconstruct any employee’s work in days from the systems where they did it. You can see what depends on them, hand their role over, and keep their work running after they leave.

one_liner.before: The company knowledge base that updates itself
one_liner.after: We reconstruct how employees actually work, so nothing breaks when…

long_description.before:
Rex is an AI-native service for order to cash. Rex replace manual operations with AI agents that continuously manage invoices, customers and exceptions.

Order to cash is a $60B outsourced function because the work is too messy for traditional automation. Every customer has different context, exceptions do not follow clean rules, and the next step is often buried in emails, portals, handoffs, or someone’s memory. Rex agents run continuously in the background and resolve work to SLA standards so cash keeps moving. We're live with pre-IPO tech companies, managing  >$500m in receivables from F100 companies, cutting manual follow-up cycles from weeks to hours.

We founded Rex after spending four years building Sequence, an a16z-backed finance ops platform, from zero to Series A — where we saw firsthand that at-scale, O2C still runs on manual labour.

Rex is the #1 winner of the Vercel AI Accelerator out of 2,500 teams, selected by Guillermo Rauch and leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, Browserbase and more.

long_description.before:
Sona8 is a voice agent that talks to every employee in a company about how their work gets done.

Each employee gets a link and talks to the agent for about 20 minutes. The agent asks follow-up questions, for example why a step is still done by hand or who else is involved. From the conversations we build process maps and a list of the problems
people described, sorted by site and team.

That is the start. We then stay on through the implementation. After each initiative is rolled out, the agent goes back to the employees involved and asks whether it was implemented and what changed in their daily work. The transformation team sees this
after every rollout step.

The result is a project management office that has talked to every employee. That context did not exist before, because nobody had the time to collect it.

Consulting firms use it to gather ideas at the start of an engagement instead. Transformation and corporate development teams use it to guide the execution of strategic transformation.
